{{ .Chart.Name }} is installed in namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} as release {{ .Release.Name }}.

Check that the manager runs (one replica holds the leader lease, the others
wait to take over):

  kubectl get pods -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  kubectl api-resources --api-group=crewlet.ai

Next, create an EngineClass, the class your companies run on, and a Company:

  https://github.com/crewlet/crewlet-operator/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md
